subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should maintainers fix this by consolidating one in-band separator-preservation PR now, or require explicit boundary metadata for streamed block separators before landing a fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent boundary contract affects shared streamed delivery semantics and two open PRs already propose related text-based fix shapes.

options.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
options.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require split/coalesced/maxChars/no-double-separator coverage, and close the other as superseded after the viable path is chosen.

options.title: Require boundary metadata
options.body: Pause the linked text-based PRs until a metadata-carrying separator contract is designed and tested through the delivery pipeline.

options.title: Reject the current fix direction
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PRs and leave this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored redesign.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
recommendation.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require split/coalesced/maxChars/no-double-separator coverage, and close the other as superseded after the viable path is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and refined the paragraph streaming behavior now at the center of the boundary contract choice.
